# Selected original dsh-context dashboard

Public source: [bowenliang123/dsh-context](https://github.com/bowenliang123/dsh-context/tree/2c8095c34da3fcef729a01437d2df65c83e08499), version **0.68.1**, commit **2c8095c34da3fcef729a01437d2df65c83e08499**. Original **Copyright 2025 bowenliang123** and [Apache 2.0](LICENSE) apply to the selected supplier files. The inspected commit has no separate NOTICE file. They are not MIT and Augmentor’s resale restriction does not replace their licence.

SOURCE.json records every selected file’s original/adapted SHA-256. Ninety-nine files are selected; twelve presentation modules carry prominent change notices: disable automatic registry checks and an unbound DSH settings shortcut, remove an unattested DSH compaction threshold, mark unobserved skill/fleet data unavailable, and bind the original request selector to explicit Pi metadata paging/body reads with unavailable-data notes. The original slash modal also receives the same picker and a recorded-data notice. The original Insights overview uses independently authored bounded Pi corpus reads, keeps calendar/range/search/sort/group/paging/navigation/chart/heatmap structure, displays reported SDK usage buckets instead of inferred historical composition, disables DSH backfill and marks unavailable skills/prices/detailed timing explicitly. The tooltip captures stable identity outside React state updaters to prevent heatmap focus/measurement loops; its original markup and CSS remain unchanged. The original settings card accepts a supported-field gate so unconnected Pi controls remain visible but disabled; private display preferences use the existing Pi settings protocol. Cards, charts, browser, dialog interactions and CSS retain the supplier structure. Unused selected modules never enter the browser graph.

Build-time module resolution binds historyPage and modelPrices to independently authored read-only Pi glue. Inline projections supply retained Pi observations; there is no supplier plugin Host, Cordis runtime, extra agent/session loop, external price/registry fetch or DSH history route in the browser graph. Tailwind 4.3.3 generates the supplier utility CSS using the original source and pinned build-only compiler; its MIT notice is included separately in the bundled notices.

See [qualification and coverage](../../../../docs/DSH-GUI-ON-PI.md#original-context-dashboard--october-11-follow-up) and [private preferences](../../../../docs/CONTEXT-PREFERENCES.md). The Context tab and original slash modal share read-only Pi projections. The preceding qualification connected Context Insights and seven display fields while sidebar placement remained unported. The sidebar follow-up below supersedes that placement status; Fleet, prompt wrapping and delegated-child attribution remain unported.

The Context sidebar follow-up adds verbatim placement.ts and binds original sidebar.ts to the copied MIT registry. Selection is 100 files: 87 verbatim / 13 marked adaptations. services.ts adds an optional scroll prop; the already adapted contextView.tsx binds separate dock-occurrence scroll ledgers/root geometry and requires a served family face before offering family navigation. Its original structure/icons/CSS and every licence body remain preserved. All other supplier bodies remain unchanged. Placement becomes the eighth display field. [Scope and qualification](../../../../docs/CONTEXT-SIDEBAR.md).
